title: Content of Premarket Submissions for Device Software Functions

source.title: Content of Premarket Submissions for Device Software Functions
source.identifier: FDA Guidance for Industry and FDA Staff, issued 2023-06-14

risk-management-records.description: `spec-objects-safety` hazard, harm, risk-estimate, and residual-risk records.

software-description.description: Customer description of device software functions, inputs, outputs, and platforms.

clauses.title: VI.A Documentation level and rationale
clauses.text: State the chosen documentation level and explain the choice using relevant submission materials.

clauses.title: VI.B Software description
clauses.text: Describe the software's principal functions, intended use, users, inputs, outputs, and computing platforms; identify material changes from an earlier submission when applicable.

clauses.title: VI.C Risk management file
clauses.text: Provide the risk-management plan, assessment of identified risks and their controls, and the resulting risk-management summary.

clauses.title: VI.D Software requirements specification
clauses.text: Present organized system or software requirements with enough trace links to relate them to other submission materials.

clauses.title: VI.E System and software architecture
clauses.text: Show the device's software modules, layers, interfaces, relationships, data movement, and interactions with users or external systems.

clauses.title: VI.F Enhanced software design specification
clauses.text: Provide technical design details that explain software behavior and show how the design implements and traces to requirements for intended use, function, safety, and effectiveness.

clauses.title: VI.G Development and configuration practices
clauses.text: Summarize lifecycle planning and configuration-management and maintenance activities, or provide a declaration of conformity to a recognized consensus standard without naming the standard.

clauses.title: VI.G Enhanced configuration and maintenance plans
clauses.text: Add complete configuration-management and maintenance plans, or a declaration of conformity to a recognized consensus standard without naming the standard.

clauses.title: VI.H Verification and validation testing
clauses.text: Summarize unit, integration, and system testing, and include a system-level protocol and report with expected and observed outcomes and pass or fail results.

clauses.title: VI.H Enhanced testing detail
clauses.text: Include unit- and integration-level test protocols and reports with expected and observed outcomes and pass or fail results.

clauses.title: VI.I Software version history
clauses.text: List tested software versions with their dates, identifiers, and concise descriptions of changes from the preceding tested version.

clauses.title: VI.J Unresolved software anomalies
clauses.text: List unresolved software anomalies and assess each one's potential effect on device safety and effectiveness.
